EP1-15-01.zh: 晚上。一大片撒滿小星星的黑色夜空，底下是一片寬闊的史前大地；低低的地平線上是暗色的山脈剪影和一整排森林。
EP1-15-01.en: Background: Night. A vast dark sky scattered with small stars over a wide prehistoric land; along the low horizon are dark silhouetted mountains and a band of forest.

EP1-15-02.zh: 晚上，跟上一格同一片天和地：撒滿小星星的黑色夜空，低低的地平線上是暗色的山脈剪影和一整排森林；火球的光把天空照亮了一點。
EP1-15-02.en: Background: Night, the same sky and land as the previous picture: a dark sky scattered with small stars, and along the low horizon dark silhouetted mountains and a band of forest; the glow of the fireball lights up the sky a little.
